text.en:
Items (l), (j) and (m), page three hundred eighty-eight, and (ad), page three hundred eighty-nine, Section two (f) of Republic Act Numbered Nineteen hundred, are hereby amended to read as follows:
"(l) San Isidro Health Center Building, Mauban Construction ₱2,500.00 "(l-a) Balibago Health Center Building, Mauban Construction 2,500.00 "(j) Maria Aurora Municipal Building Construction and/or repair 5,000.00 "(m) Bagong Bayan-Sadsaran Road, Mauban Completion 4,500.00 "(ad) Sabang Barrio School, Polillo Construction 5,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1961.
